description: Looks up whether a tokenized version of a company, ETF or bond exists, and from which issuer, by company name, ticker or ISIN. Sources: issuer catalogues (Backed / xStocks, Ondo Global Markets, Dinari, Robinhood, Coinbase, Backpack, Reality (Bitget), ST0x, Jarsy, Midas, Lofty), Swiss SME share registers (Aktionariat), Japanese security tokens, El Salvador's CNAD register (registered offerings; sale not confirmed), European and Asian digital bonds from official registers, and an aggregated tier (CoinGecko). One company can be tokenized several times (e.g. Apple as seven tokens); each row states issuer, legal form, chain and targetArea (the issuer's stated audience, not an eligibility check) and its source authority: aggregated rows only observe that a token exists and carry no KYC gate or custody claim. Identity data only: yield, minimum and risk grade are absent, not zero.

include_halted.description: Include instruments Backed has flagged as trading-halted. Default false.

issuer.description: Restrict to one issuer. Omitted: all issuers.

line.description: Backed only. xstocks = the xStocks line; btokens = the older bToken DeFi line.

offset.description: Number of matches to skip; the nextOffset of a previous answer continues from there (absent at the end).

query.description: Company name, ticker or ISIN — e.g. "Apple", "AAPL", "US0378331005", "Silver Trust"

name: find_tokenized_security

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; absent when there is no more

title: Find a tokenized security
